title: OpenClaw real local file-operation proof
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench';$target=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-tool-proof.txt';Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$prompt='Create exactly this file on the local Windows machine: C:\3EN-Agent\workbench\openclaw-tool-proof.txt . Put exactly this single line in it: OPENCLAW_FILE_TOOL_OK . Do not only describe what to do; actually use your available local file/shell tools to create the file. After doing it, reply with exactly FILE_CREATED_OK';$out=& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key '3en-057a' --message $prompt --json --timeout 180 2>&1;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;$raw=$out|Out-String;Write-Output $raw;if($code -ne 0){throw ('OPENCLAW_AGENT_FAILED code='+$code)};if(-not(Test-Path $target)){throw 'OPENCLAW_FILE_NOT_CREATED'};$content=(Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim();if($content -ne 'OPENCLAW_FILE_TOOL_OK'){throw ('OPENCLAW_FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH='+$content)};if($raw -notmatch 'FILE_CREATED_OK'){throw 'OPENCLAW_CONFIRMATION_MISSING'};Write-Output 'V430_057A_FILE_TOOL=PASS'
